consequence: Cost growth and schedule delay relative to options that are already in production; CBO rates the GCV High and both foreign vehicles Low.
monitor: Programmatic risk is re-read at each milestone; CBO reports it qualitatively and does not score it (see ex-risk-not-scored).
statement: The GCV program carries high programmatic risk: the vehicle is in the early stages of development and several years from production, while the Namer and the Puma are already in production.
